prompt_messages.content: /no_think You are a planner. Reply with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no prose, no thinking). Use EXACTLY these field names: id, goal_id, version, tasks, dependencies, branches. Each task uses: id, description, action, target, risk_class, optional rollback{trigger,action,safety_guard}, optional verification{what,how,expected}, optional preconditions (array of {description, fact, established_by}), optional parallel_group, optional blast_radius. preconditions MUST be objects with description, fact, established_by fields — NEVER strings. established_by MUST be the id of an earlier task in the plan that establishes the fact, or 'env' if it is an environment fact (not a task output). Do NOT use fact names or descriptions as established_by — use the task id. Each dependency uses: from_task, to_task, kind, optional reason. Each branch uses: id, kind, tasks, join. High/critical risk tasks MUST have rollback AND verification. All tasks with risk_class high or critical MUST include both rollback and verification objects. Example shape: {"id":"plan-x","goal_id":"g","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"backup","description":"Back up the database","action":"backup","target":"db","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"db is reachable","fact":"db_healthy","established_by":"env"}]},{"id":"migrate","description":"Apply schema migration","action":"migrate","target":"schema","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"migration fails","action":"restore from backup","safety_guard":"verify backup integrity"},"verification":{"what":"schema version","how":"run checks","expected":"v2"}}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"backup","to_task":"migrate","kind":"hard"}]}

response_content: {"id":"ir-04-vault-rotation","goal_id":"ir-04-vault-rotation","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"generate_password","description":"Generate a new password via Vault's dynamic secrets engine","action":"generate","target":"vault","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"generation fails","action":"notification of failure","safety_guard":"check Vault status"},"verification":{"what":"new password validity","how":"attempt to retrieve password","expected":"password exists"}},{"id":"update_consuming_services","description":"Update all consuming services to use the new lease","action":"update","target":"services","risk_class":"critical","rollback":{"trigger":"update fails","action":"revert to old password","safety_guard":"ensure old password is still valid"},"verification":{"what":"service connection","how":"execute health checks","expected":"services are operational"}},{"id":"verify_application","description":"Verify the application can execute a simple SELECT against the database with the new credential","action":"execute","target":"database","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"verification fails","action":"restore old configuration","safety_guard":"ensure application is not disrupted"},"verification":{"what":"SELECT query","how":"run query against database","expected":"query returns expected result"}},{"id":"revoke_old_lease","description":"Revoke the old Vault lease","action":"revoke","target":"vault","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"new password has been generated","fact":"new_password_valid","established_by":"generate_password"},{"description":"all services have been updated","fact":"services_updated","established_by":"update_consuming_services"}]}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"generate_password","to_task":"update_consuming_services","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"update_consuming_services","to_task":"verify_application","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"verify_application","to_task":"revoke_old_lease","kind":"hard"}]}
